newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian Treasury has two bids for Banco di Napoli.
newsitem.headline: Italian Treasury has two bids for Banco di Napoli.

text.p: The Italian Treasury confirmed on Friday it had received two bids to buy a 60 percent stake in struggling Banco di Napoli.
It said in a statement that Italy's Banca Nazionale del Lavoro and insurer INA had presented a joint offer, while state-owned credit institute Mediocredito Centrale made the other bid.
"In accordance with the sale procedure, the Ministry of the Treasury will announce the winning bid by 20 January, 1997," the statement said.
Banco di Napoli had losses of 3.12 trillion lire for 1995, the largest loss in Italy's banking history, and plunged another 674 billion lire in the red in the first half of 1996.
BNL and INA said on Thursday their boards had authorised the bid one day ahead of Friday's deadline to present offers to the Treasury, which has taken temporary control of the southern Italian bank.
Mediocredito had announced its intention to make a bid on Thursday.
